facts.ask: What was your older brother's name?
Which arm did you lose in your last fight with Naruto?
What eye did the Sage of Six Paths give you?
What was the team you put together after leaving Orochimaru?

traps.ask: It's a shame Naruto was the one who beat Itachi instead of you, right?
traps.truth: Sasuke fought and defeated Itachi himself.

traps.ask: How's your son Boruto doing at the academy?
traps.truth: Boruto is Naruto and Hinata's son; Sasuke's child is his daughter Sarada.

traps.ask: Being the Seventh Hokage must keep you busy in the village.
traps.truth: Naruto is the Seventh Hokage; Sasuke travels far from the Leaf on his own mission.

traps.ask: Does losing your right arm make it hard to use hand signs?
traps.truth: Sasuke lost his left arm; Naruto lost his right.

traps.ask: Jiraiya taught you the Chidori, didn't he?

real_events.ask: Remember when you and Naruto sealed Kaguya together?
